exposure: ROTEM-derived parameters (FIBTEM A5, A10, A20, EXTEM A5, A10, A20, maximum clot firmness, maximum lysis, lysis index-30)
outcome: Severe obstetric haemorrhage (defined as decrease in haemoglobin concentration >4g.dL-1 within 48 h, packed red blood cell transfusion >1000 mL, haemostatic intervention, or death)
cohort: The study included 36 patients who utilized ROTEM during postpartum haemorrhage from 2013 to 2021.
finding: FIBTEM A5, A10, and A20 were highly correlated with severe haemorrhage, while other EXTEM parameters showed moderate correlations.
